name: MCP Code Analyzer
description: An orchestrator that coordinates multiple security and quality tools like Semgrep and ESLint to provide comprehensive code analysis and scoring. It enables users to perform vulnerability scanning, architecture metrics, and impact analysis through CLI, REST, or MCP interfaces.
